module_title: Unique Lakes, Craters, and Picturesque Falls
introduction: Examiners love to ask about lakes that are famous for a geographical uniqueness (like being formed by a meteor, or floating), and waterfalls that form state borders.

core_concepts.title: Lonar Lake
core_concepts.description:
State: **Maharashtra** (Buldhana district).
Key Feature: It is a **Crater Lake** created by a meteorite impact thousands of years ago. It was recently in the news because its water suddenly turned pink.

core_concepts.title: Loktak Lake
core_concepts.description:
State: **Manipur**.
Key Feature: It is the largest freshwater lake in North-East India. It is famous for its floating islands called **'Phumdis'**. The world's only floating national park (Keibul Lamjao) is located on it.

core_concepts.title: Pulicat Lake
core_concepts.description:
State: **Border of Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu**.
Key Feature: It is the second-largest brackish water lagoon in India after Chilika. The Satish Dhawan Space Centre (Sriharikota) is located on a barrier island separating this lake from the Bay of Bengal.

core_concepts.title: Waterfalls of Central and Western India
core_concepts.description:
1. **Dhuandhar Falls:** **Madhya Pradesh** (Jabalpur). It cascades down the marble rocks of Bhedaghat on the **Narmada River**.
2. **Dudhsagar Falls:** Located on the border of **Goa and Karnataka**. Literally meaning 'Sea of Milk', it is formed by the **Mandovi River**.

important_entities.name: Sambhar Lake
important_entities.significance: While Chilika is on the coast (lagoon), Sambhar Lake is right in the middle of **Rajasthan** (inland). It produces a massive portion of India's salt.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: Pulicat Lake spans two states. Roughly 96% of it is in **Andhra Pradesh** and 4% is in **Tamil Nadu**. If forced to choose a single state in an MCQ, choose Andhra Pradesh.

exam_strategy_tips: A favorite State PCS/UPSC question: 'Which lake in India was formed by a meteorite impact?' Answer: Lonar Lake (Maharashtra).
